solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Mountan"** is incorrect and should be spelled as** *****"Mountain"**.* "Mountan" does not have a meaning in English. (पर्वत)

 
 
• **Example: **The climbers reached the peak of the mountain after a grueling ascent.
 
 
 
• **"Mountain" **refers to a large natural elevation of the earth's surface rising abruptly from the surrounding level. (पर्वत)
 
 
• **Example: **The view from the top of the*** mountain ***was breathtaking.
 
 

Hence, the correct spelling is **"Mountain"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Weekend **(सप्ताहांत): The period from Friday evening through Sunday evening, especially regarded as a time for leisure.

 
 
• **Example:** We plan to go hiking this ***weekend.***
 
 
 
• **Dessert **(मिठाई): The sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.
 
 
• **Example: **She made a delicious chocolate cake for ***dessert.***
 
 
 
• **Journey** (यात्रा): An act of traveling from one place to another.
 
 
• **Example:** The*** journey ***to the remote village was long and tiring.
